# My Visa Assistance

> Visa information and application assistance for Indian passport holders. A BTW Visa Initiative. The site publishes country visa guides, work visa guides, visa requirement checklists and tools, and offers help preparing applications by phone, WhatsApp and email.

My Visa Assistance is a private service. It is not a government agency, embassy, consulate or visa application centre, and it does not guarantee visa decisions. Country guides marked "checked against official sources" list those sources and the date they were checked.

## Visa services

Every service uses official requirements, one named consultant and progress updates at every stage. Visa decisions are made only by embassies and immigration authorities.

- [Visa services](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/): All visa services, from a single consultation to end-to-end support
- [Visa consultation](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/visa-consultation/): the right visa, eligibility check and requirements overview; first consultation free
- [Visa documentation](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/visa-documentation/): personalised checklist and help preparing cover letters, itineraries and supporting documents
- [Visa application assistance](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/visa-application-assistance/): help completing official online visa forms accurately
- [Visa appointment assistance](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/visa-appointment-assistance/): help booking embassy or visa centre appointments and preparing for biometrics or interviews
- [Application review](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/application-review/): an expert check of a completed application before submission
- [End-to-end visa support](https://myvisaassistance.com/services/end-to-end-visa-support/): one named consultant for every stage, with progress updates until the decision
